meta.name: auth-implementation-patterns
meta.description: Master authentication and authorization patterns including JWT, OAuth2, session management, and RBAC to build secure, scalable access control systems. Use when implementing auth systems, securing APIs, or debugging security issues.

copy.tagline: 为应用加上登录认证和权限校验,防止未授权访问
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发应用并需要实现用户登录和权限管理
copy.tagline_en: Add login and permission checks to your app to block unauthorized access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building an app and need to add user login and permission management

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 JWT、OAuth2、会话管理和 RBAC 等模式帮你实现认证与授权,给出代码方案,并附密码哈希、HTTPS、令牌有效期等安全要点。
howto.when: 当你实现认证系统、保护 REST 或 GraphQL API,或排查登录与安全问题时接管。

say.text: 帮我用 JWT 给这个 API 加上登录和权限校验
say.note: 会给出令牌签发与校验的实现方案

say.text: 登录接口怎么防暴力破解?
say.note: 会给出限流等安全实践建议

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude helps you implement authentication and authorization using JWT, OAuth2, session management, and RBAC — giving code patterns plus security points like password hashing, HTTPS, and token expiry.
howto.when_en: Use it when implementing auth systems, securing REST or GraphQL APIs, or debugging login and security issues.

say_en.text: Add JWT login and permission checks to this API
say_en.note: Gives token issuing and verification patterns

say_en.text: How do I stop brute-force attacks on login?
say_en.note: Suggests rate limiting and related practices

say_en.text: How do I switch to OAuth2 Google login?
say_en.note: Explains the flow and callback handling
